messages:
Ravi: Heads-up: we're scheduling a targeted base-image rebuild to remediate CVE-glibc and update the signing layout. Window: Mon 02:00 UTC. Need RBAC + keystore gating owners.
Jo: I'll own RBAC changes. What's the new signing path?
Ravi: Old: /keystore/sign. New: /keystore/supplychain/sign/v3. Runtime attestors will need read on that path only.
Lina: We'll introduce sbom-uploader-sa that writes to supplychain-audit. Please ensure producers are limited.
Asha: Strong preference: separate audit topic and 7y retention. Also require keystore grants to be short-lived (<= 20m) and brokered.
sec-bot: [alert] New libcurl CVE linked to base:v1.6; flagged for rebuild (ticket SEC-3512).
Jo: Proposed ClusterRole (brief): supplychain-sign-read -> verbs: get,list on attest nodes API group. Will scope binding to runtime namespaces.
Ravi: Also need a role for image-signer with only `cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner`. No decrypt or encrypt.
Lina: Broker flow example: broker issues JWT with aud=keystore-broker, ttl=1200s, logs grant id to keystore-access.log.
Asha: Add CI gate: require SBOM artifact and attestation.passed before promoting to prod. If missing, block.
Jo: I'll add an infra PR for RBAC and a small `scripts/check_bindings.sh` job in CI.
Ravi: Plan: 01:30 preflight checks, 02:00 staging bake+sign, 03:00 staging canary, 04:00 prod cutover if green. SRE oncall please monitor.
sec-bot: [reminder] All KMS grants must be recorded in keystore-access.log and forwarded to splunk:audit.
Lina: If signing mismatches occur, abort and rollback to previous image tag, capture keystore & broker logs, open SEC-IR.
Jo: Pushing RBAC PR now. Will ping when CI passes.
Ravi: Thanks team :thumbsup:
